uniform_standard.description: Marker-specific standard candidate criteria applied identically at every spatial location; Iba1 is withheld until labels are frozen

uniform_sensitive.description: Globally smaller and lower-LoG marker-only criteria with the exact numeric object and rescue raw-intensity floors frozen from the standard marker-only segmentation of the same stack, applied identically at every spatial location; never conditioned on Iba1

mptp_th_intensity_floor_sensitivity.description: Marker-only standard-detector bracket; every floor is applied identically to Sham and MPTP, and alternative candidate fields reuse the frozen primary Iba1 mask and exact primary torus shift field

mask_sensitivity.description: Primary Iba1 factor 0.80 is tested against raw-image factor 0.70/0.90 rebuilds, no-fragment-cutoff and 0/0.15 um closing-radius rebuilds, physical -0.1/0/+0.1 um offsets, acquired-voxel stress tests, stricter fragment-volume cutoffs, and capped/legacy hole filling; observed and null are always recomputed together
